item.title: Luan 0.1.0 (Build 18)
item.description:
• New: sound sources (Pro). Add a third-party sound source from its luan.json URL; Luan shows what it contains and asks you to confirm first.
  • Add the official sound source in one click. It carries an "Official" badge.
  • When a sound source has an update, Luan asks before downloading it.
  • A damaged sound source can be repaired on its own.
  • Sounds from sound sources are only ever turned down, never up, so they don't play louder than the built-in sounds.
  • Faster downloads: adding the official sound source now takes about 12 seconds instead of about 97.
  • Settings icons use brighter system colors, and the Integrations page has its puzzle icon back.
  • License seats are limited to 1, 3, or 5 Macs.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26 or later. Ad-hoc signed and not notarized by Apple. Test license activation is still simulated and does not represent a purchase.
